edb65936e259b2625e8eea4628316c4577cb2a11.body:
The AppDispatch base class dispatches user-controlled actions in its
constructor via dispatchActions() and terminates with render() + exit()
before any calling code can enforce ACL checks. Any authenticated user
could invoke controller methods like getNotificationLog() to access
patient PHI regardless of ACL permissions.

Add verifyAcl() check in the constructor before dispatchActions() so
unautho

6e9e1566d6e271a6d839614674b887e3a73d7da1.subject: Merge commit from fork
6e9e1566d6e271a6d839614674b887e3a73d7da1.body:
Wrap $edata['table_args'] and $edata['checksum'] with js_escape()
in portal_payment.php to prevent stored XSS via the single-quoted
JavaScript string literal. A patient portal user could inject
arbitrary JS that executes in a staff member's browser session.

21dee7658a5f3b18c5750e3fae7324e875c1703a.subject: Merge commit from fork
21dee7658a5f3b18c5750e3fae7324e875c1703a.body:
For non-admin users, force-override sentBy and sentTo parameters
to the current user's ID regardless of user input. Previously the
guard only applied when both parameters were absent, allowing a
non-admin user to view other users' reminders by supplying either
parameter.

c32139b5144b1c704015221520ad2f931e25f10d.subject: Merge commit from fork

70a41122c6d75ebcd219ba2a2535e93a6c188151.subject: Merge commit from fork
70a41122c6d75ebcd219ba2a2535e93a6c188151.body:
Add escapeHtml() helper and use it when building highlight spans in
hiliteTree(). Text content from DOM text nodes may contain browser-decoded
HTML entities (e.g., < becomes <). Without escaping, these are re-parsed
as HTML when passed to jQuery's $() constructor, enabling stored XSS.

dccc962f06bdf6105ca85c277915167caf3e7c28.subject: Merge commit from fork
dccc962f06bdf6105ca85c277915167caf3e7c28.body:

template to prevent injection of arbitrary HTML.

c3a47c37619cdb4f0aaa168e39a93ab1d106429c.subject: Merge commit from fork
c3a47c37619cdb4f0aaa168e39a93ab1d106429c.body:
Verify vital ownership (pid/eid) before allowing updates in the PUT
vital API endpoint and the legacy vitals form save path. An attacker
could supply another patient's vid to modify their vitals.

This complements the existing fix for the POST endpoint which strips
user-supplied ids on insert.

ddcf04ea769a33cdc1932355224575478df70585.subject: Merge commit from fork
ddcf04ea769a33cdc1932355224575478df70585.body:
Apply basename() to uploaded DICOM filenames to prevent path traversal.
An attacker could upload a file named "../../../var/www/shell.php" to
write files outside the temporary directory.

This complements the existing fix for the zip destination path
(study_name).

0ef9b1763029e52d43fcb4fd0ebb0769a7ec43d4.subject: Merge commit from fork
0ef9b1763029e52d43fcb4fd0ebb0769a7ec43d4.body:
Add deny precedence to zhAclCheck so explicit deny ACLs (user or
group) override allow ACLs. Previously only allow entries were
queried, so a user explicitly denied a module section could still
access it through a group allow.

Precedence order: user deny > user allow > group deny > group allow.

524e57a57215f248920d18f155b34c28b12b8f79.subject: Merge commit from fork
524e57a57215f248920d18f155b34c28b12b8f79.body:
The billing tracker AJAX endpoint was missing the ACL check present in the
parent UI. Any authenticated user could access claim metadata (x12 filenames,
payer info, transmission status). Add the same acct/eob or acct/bill write
permission check.

ca9657862dd0310b0834d34ffee47c760ce2293c.body:

annotation text in the Graphical Pain Map legend. The previous code
decoded user input and injected it directly into an HTML string passed
to jQuery's $() constructor, allowing stored XSS attacks.

ad1f3b3861e2fb3cc078fdb64843c876c9fdd615.body:

Add pid to the WHERE clause in MessageService::update(), matching the
existing pattern in delete(). Previously, the UPDATE and preceding
SELECT used only the message id, allowing an authenticated user to
read and modify any patient's notes by supplying another message id.

233c736b007ef2961ad2dd747457b58908ccdfbd.subject: Merge commit from fork
233c736b007ef2961ad2dd747457b58908ccdfbd.body:
Remove any id field from the request data before passing it to

service to perform an UPDATE instead of INSERT, allowing an attacker to
overwrite any patient's vitals by providing another patient's vital id.

03fb5d6de92896d66297fd34590aead27f4c736a.body:
Add patient ownership checks to view_action() and retrieve_action() in
the document controller. Previously, any authenticated user could view
or retrieve documents belonging to other patients by enumerating
document IDs. The document's foreign_id (patient) is now verified
against the requested patient_id before exposing any data.

02a6a7793402b10356a94626d78e0e1069e92a77.subject: Merge commit from fork
02a6a7793402b10356a94626d78e0e1069e92a77.body:
The skip_timeout_reset request parameter was guarding both the session
expiration check and the expiration timer reset. An expired session
could bypass forced logout by appending ?skip_timeout_reset=1 to any
request.

Restructure the conditional so the expiration check always runs. Only
the timer reset is skipped for background polling requests (Messages,
Reminders, Flow Board).

a29c0f7ac0975429a85cd09a3ff12ee0dcdb4478.body:
Portal users could forge provider signatures by:
1. Setting type=admin-signature to bypass patient PID checks
2. Specifying arbitrary user IDs in POST data

- Override user parameter with session PID for portal requests

Fixes GHSA-xc8x-mfh8-9xvh
